scope: Prospective same-host measurements of three synthetic concrete VST3 processor callbacks. This file contains no observed timings and establishes no realtime, audio-device, perceptual or measured-instrument claim.
freeze_policy: Retain the exact plan and its hash before the first formal measurement. Changing profiles, order, repetition counts, affinity policy or analysis rules requires a new plan/version; preserve this one. Actual measured source and binary identities are bound separately at execution.

execution.build_policy: Finish all compilation before capture. Use a Release build without sanitizer instrumentation; retain actual flags, LTO/fast-math state and linkage. No code, compiled input or executable mutation during capture. Never infer complete flags from NDEBUG or the Release label.
execution.run_policy: Run the 72 argv lists sequentially, one new process per list; no concurrent benchmark processes, build/test/render/reference work, intentional idle delay, adaptive repetition or discarded outlier. Other workers perform read-only/lightweight work and their competing activity is recorded.

affinity_policy.selection: Before the first measurement choose the lowest logical CPU in os.sched_getaffinity(0). Pin each benchmark child to exactly that CPU before exec; record the allowed mask, chosen CPU and verified child mask.
affinity_policy.on_failure: Abort this protocol with an operational record if a stable single permitted CPU cannot be selected or applied. Do not silently fall back or alter system-wide affinity.
affinity_policy.note: The executable does not set affinity; its raw uncontrolled string stays unchanged. The external execution record supplies the observed launcher policy.

execution.priority_and_power: Retain inherited scheduling policy, priority, frequency/power policy and container limits; do not change system settings. Record unavailable information explicitly.
execution.destination_policy: Create a new result directory exclusively. Create every raw/output/execution file exclusively; preserve bytes, exit codes, timeouts and unattempted-run inventory. Never overwrite or automatically retry a run.
execution.platform_path_policy: These argv paths target the current Linux build. Resolving them to absolute paths without changing arguments is permitted and must be recorded. Another platform or affinity policy needs a separately identified plan.

timed_boundary.included: Exactly the concrete RhodesProcessor::process call: host getters, validation, ownership, automation, output clearing, rendering and mailbox publication, plus timer overhead and scheduling interruptions.
timed_boundary.excluded: Process launch, setup, schedule construction, allocation, warmup, lifecycle resets, baseline parameter flush, sentinels, output verification, hashing, sorting and JSON serialization.
timed_boundary.clock_metadata: Record clock identity and nominal C++ steady_clock period/is_steady from the same toolchain when available; any external clock probe is labeled as such. Retain raw durations and report unavailable resolution rather than inferring it from wall time.
timed_boundary.warmup_and_initial_state: Each executable warms its own declared schedule then resets mechanics, owners, gain and sustain before the measured phase. Initial normalized gain is 0.5, sustain is false; strike intensity is binary32 0.7.

ordering.round_1_variant_order: Rotate [direct, filtered, quadrature] left by zero-based profile index modulo three.
ordering.round_2_variant_order: Reverse that same profile's round-one order.
ordering.position_balance: Across 12 profiles and two rounds each variant appears eight times at each of the three positions.
ordering.purpose: Reduce a systematic order preference while retaining every observation; two rounds do not establish independence or statistical significance.

required_execution_evidence.plan: Exact plan bytes and SHA-256; canonical plan hash verified; protocol document SHA-256; launcher source/argv and hash; requested and actual run order.
required_execution_evidence.source_and_binary: Git commit/tree/status and relevant diff, hashes of all actual compiled project sources/headers and generated coefficients, CMake configuration/compile/link commands and cache, compiler path/version, pinned SDK root/submodule identities and cleanliness, executable paths/SHA-256 and dynamic linkage. Repeat compiled-input/binary hashes after capture; a difference invalidates a single-build comparison.
required_execution_evidence.machine: OS/distribution/kernel/architecture, CPU model/features/topology, logical/available CPU masks, physical-vs-virtual information if exposed, RAM, cgroup v1/v2 CPU quota/period/cpuset/memory limit and source paths, affinity before/after and each child binding, scheduler/priority, frequency governor/turbo/power information when exposed. Record not available rather than inventing values.
required_execution_evidence.clock_and_load: UTC and monotonic run boundaries, timed clock identity/nominal period availability, executable rounding-mode field, unchanged raw FTZ-not-inspected statement, CPU/load and process activity before/after, known competing builds/tests/reference runs or other workers, and any interruption. No clock or scheduling outlier is removed.
required_execution_evidence.per_run: Exact argv, cwd, environment/affinity choices, start/end, return code or signal/timeout, stdout/stderr/execution-record paths and hashes, raw schema-version-1 JSON including complete/integrity and every timing.raw_callback_us value. Preserve unrecorded raw metadata fields; complete them in a separate manifest.
required_execution_evidence.retained_summary: All 72 results, failures and omissions; all 36 paired same-variant fingerprints; timing statistics rederived from raw arrays; source/binary before-after checks; limits. Retain raw JSONs in a durable repository evidence artifact or lossless self-contained archive with documented decoding and hashes, not only scratch paths.

validation_and_analysis.identity: Require expected plugin/model/latency and exact workload fields. Direct/filtered require correct uniform factor and internal rate; quadrature requires nodes=6 and its scheme, and forbids the two uniform-rate fields.
validation_and_analysis.integrity: A numerically complete run has exit 0, complete true, all requested warmup/measured callbacks, zero failed callbacks, finite output/checksum, equal stereo, correct silence/output-presence flags, expected frame cursor, owners and getter counts. All raw durations must be finite and nonnegative. Retain and label other runs incomplete; their timing values cannot support successful-workload comparisons.
validation_and_analysis.repeat_policy: For each profile and variant compare round-one/two output fields exactly and record every mismatch. Do not expect identical output across variants or sample formats. A repeat mismatch is an integrity finding, not a reason to discard the slower run.
validation_and_analysis.summary_rule: For each run independently recompute count, mean, nearest-rank p50/p95/p99, maximum, nominal period and number of durations strictly greater than that period. Reproduce means with ordinary ordered binary64 addition and additionally audit with math.fsum; preserve any rounding-level difference. Percentile index is ceil(N*p/100)-1. Report both rounds separately, their maxima and all nominal misses.
validation_and_analysis.deadline_rule: Nominal period in microseconds is 1e6*block_frames/sample_rate_hz. No deadline threshold is a success gate for this measurement campaign. Zero observed misses is not proof of future deadline compliance; observed misses are not measured device underruns.
validation_and_analysis.comparisons: Within one profile/round, callback-time ratios are descriptive same-host observations. Do not pool profiles or assert causal speedup, an isolated float-format/polyphony effect, statistical significance, worst-case execution time or a real-DAW result.
validation_and_analysis.interruption_policy: Preserve failed processes and attempted runs. Stop on compiled-input/binary change or loss of the declared execution environment; record the remaining runs as unattempted. Any further campaign uses a fresh result directory and links the retained interrupted attempt.

limitations: Synthetic impulse/switched-loss source; offline contact solver and measured specimen data are absent.
Concrete linked processors are timed; SDK loading, GUI, commercial DAW, device pacing and wake-up jitter are excluded.
A 12-profile finite matrix is not exhaustive and does not include every key/rate/control history or long-tail denormal regime.
Two counterbalanced rounds and raw callbacks do not prove independent samples, statistical significance or worst-case deadlines.
Allocation/locking policy and quadrature reference-error evidence remain separate.
A prior single exploratory quadrature run with concurrent build activity is excluded from the formal campaign and does not determine its pass/fail limits.
plan_hash_rule: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(document_without_plan_sha256, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False).
